# The White Witch™

> Mira builds LibreSky, Vesper, and RETRO Center. LibreSky is a Bluesky client. Vesper plays music and video. RETRO Center powers on the old machines. Emoji games, MAGIC, and FAUX NEWS sit beside them. Mail: thewhitewitchtm@google.com.

No accounts on this site. The work is linked below.

## LibreSky

- [LibreSky](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/LibreSky/): Bluesky client in the browser. Edit, AI, voice, video, and chat.
- [LibreSky source](https://github.com/TheWhiteWitchTM/LibreSky)

## On the desk

- [Vesper](https://github.com/TheWhiteWitchTM/vesper): music and video for the quiet hours. Runs from its own folder.
- [RETRO Center](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/whitewitch/magic/retro/center/): a shelf for the C64, the Apple II, the TI-99/4A, the Amiga, and the Atari ST.
